svg.title: Figure 2. The instance at c = 0.1: r(tau) on the bound Schwarzschild orbit [10, 20] (M = 1) with the two Kretschmann targets at the first three turning points
svg.text: τ (proper time along the orbit; no scale shown)
Black: the orbit [10, 20]; dots: turning points (K-vertices). Dashed: the two jump targets, ±ε n̂, at c = 0.1.
Green dot: target passes realisation (a). Red cross: target fails (a). Radii only as pinned in Appendix A.
